verdict.rationale: Ardent's core product is isolated, instant copies of production Postgres that coding agents can test against, including destructive operations, "without touching production." Branch URLs have zero access to the original database, and agents can be scoped to only their own branch, with per-PR fresh branches in CI. Community comments raise a caveat about side effects outside the DB (e.g., external API calls) but do not contradict the DB isolation itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Ardent's isolation in practice, and no evidenced synthetic/masked-data option for agents that shouldn't see real data.
